MarriageSecretBook:
Marriage Guide For Farmers
Before you ask someone to marry you, you'll have to date them for a while first (Ask someone to date you with a bouquet from Pierre's).
 When you're ready to pop the big question, you'll need to give them a 'Mermaid's Pendant'. Everyone knows what it means when you present them with one of those.
 It's rumored that on stormy days, a mermaid can be seen along the shores of Stardew Valley, carrying such a pendant.
 After the wedding ceremony, your partner will move in with you. Remember to treat your spouse well... They still like gifts even after marriage!
 
(Paid for by Pierre)
Beach_Mariner_PlayerMarried: I'm pleased to see the pendant has found its place with you, {0}.
Beach_Mariner_PlayerHasItem: Let not hesitation hold you back. Present the pendant to the one with whom your heart finds a home.
Beach_Mariner_PlayerNotUpgradedHouse: The light in your eyes speaks of deep affection, {0}. Such love seeks a home where it can grow and thrive.

Beach_Mariner_PlayerNoRelationship: This pendant awaits those wanting to share their life's journey. Yet, it seems you might not be ready to take that step, {0}.
NoSecret: {{name}}: Today, the sea keeps its secrets veiled.
BeachSupplyCrate: A crate drifted ashore with the morning tide.
AlsoBeachSupplyCrate: Also, a crate drifted ashore with the morning tide.
SummerForageCalendar: When the summer sun warms the waves, the ocean turns a vibrant green, yielding its bounties plentifully.
WormBinUpgrade: Within decomposing driftwood lies a sanctuary for tiny creatures. Consider adding some to your worm bins.
MermaidSecretNote: Once, I knew sea-sister who murmured the numbers 1-5-4-2-3 in her sleep.
MermaidSecretNote_Mermaid: Have you met a sea-sister with blue hair? She murmurs the numbers 1-5-4-2-3 in her sleep.
MermaidSecretNote_MermaidBlueHair: Have you met a sea-sister with blue hair akin to mine? She murmurs the numbers 1-5-4-2-3 in her sleep.

WillyLifeSaver: A local fisherman once lost a lifesaver, tangled in the waves as he leapt from his boat.
TownTrashCanBrokenCommunityCenter: Seagulls speak of a dilapidated building in town. Someone tried to discard something in nearby waters that will never reach the sea.
TownTrashCanRestoredCommunityCenter: Seagulls speak of a recently restored building in town. Someone tried to discard something in nearby waters that will never reach the sea.
TownTrashCanJojaWareHouse: Seagulls speak of a new blue building in town. Someone tried to discard something in nearby waters that will never reach the sea.
SecretWoodsWallBasket: Woodskip whispers tell of someone dropping their basket into their pond.
DesertPyramidDecal: Sandfish tales speak of a hidden pond harboring ancient treasures.
SpaPaintingAndNecklace: Raindrops shared with me how they evaporated outside a local spa, where people lost many curious things.
SpaPaintingOrNecklace: Raindrops shared with me they met you before evaporating outside a local spa. They wish for you to discover another curious thing there.
IridiumKrobusReady: You display mastery in the art of fishing. With such expertise, you appear poised to uncover something special in the river south of the sewers.

IslandGourmandStatue: Tales speak of stingrays in a hidden cove on a distant isle, safeguarding a beautiful sunken statue in their home.
VolcanoPainting: I've heard stories of lava eels atop a volcano on a distant isle, renowned for their determined artistry.
IslandFrogHat: Among the local frogs on a distant isle, a legend persists of a gluttonous frog. It is said their domain also shelters a small, slippery companion eager to explore.
IslandPainting: On the northern part of a distant isle, whispers speak of a secret nestled on the riverbed, reachable only through a hidden grove. This one may prove challenging to uncover.
IslandSquirrel: Stories of a distant isle tell of a secret concealed on a riverbed, reachable only by traversing lava. This one may prove challenging to uncover.

SwimMod_Mariner_Questions_Yes_Old: I thought so, hee hee! Then, let us see if you can answer my questions. First...
